title: The Hidden Runner
format: 3v1 in a grid, then 3v1 plus a keeper
area: 40m x 28m, a goal at the right hand end (7m wide)
kit: Red and Blue bibs, keeper in a third colour, cones for the grid
start: B1 starts with the ball, R1 defends in the middle

steps.say: B1 plays to B2 who has come to show for the ball. R1 steps up.
steps.vo: B1 plays into B2, who has come short to show for the ball. R1 steps up to stay tight. B3 waits wide.

steps.say: B3 starts the run as the ball is played. R1 is watching the ball, not the runner.
steps.vo: B3 starts the run the moment the ball is played. R1 is watching the ball and cannot see him. That is why we call him the hidden runner.

steps.say: B2 lays it off first time into the path of B3.
steps.vo: B2 lays it off first time, into the path of B3. One touch, no delay, and R1 is out of the game.

steps.say: B3 has run beyond R1 and is through on goal.
steps.vo: B3 has run beyond R1, and now he is through on goal. He does not wait, he drives straight at the keeper.

steps.say: B3 shoots first time. B2 follows in for the rebound.
steps.vo: B3 shoots. B2 follows in for any rebound, because the first player should always be ready for the second ball.

setup: Three Blue players (B1, B2, B3) against one Red defender (R1).
A cone gate marks the halfway line, and a goal at the right hand end.
Run it unopposed first, then add R1.
rules: B2 must play first time after the pass from B1.
B3 must start the run only after the ball is played, not before.
Offside applies from the halfway line.
restart: Ball out of play or a goal: B1 restarts with a new ball from the left.
The defender rotates after each attack.
points: Start the run when the ball is played, not before.
One touch from the lay off player: first time, with pace.
Run beyond the defender and away from his eyeline.
First player follows the pass to support the attack.
progress: Add a second defender, so it is 3v2.
Add a keeper and ask the group to score within eight seconds of the first pass.
Play it in a game: award a bonus point for every goal with a third man run.
